D: Vampire flatmates in Wellington deal with chores, rivals and a new recruit.
P: Serve the hot chips when Nick tries to eat one.
S: Nick's ill-advised attempt to eat a chip
Thick chips fried twice until crunchy, salted hot and served in a paper cone, with aioli for the humans.
Toasted baguette with whipped goat's cheese, roasted beetroot and blood orange segments, a drizzle of honey.
a snack the flatmates could actually stand
Tomato, basil, olive oil and salt piled on toasted ciabatta, no garlic in sight for once.
M: Stu's welcome dinner at the flat
Beef sirloin seared and roasted rare, rested, sliced thin and piled into soft rolls with horseradish cream and rocket.
Black pudding sliced and fried crisp, buttery mash, caramelised onions and a red wine gravy.

s.note: Nick's ill-advised attempt to eat a chip
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak and dry. Fry at 150C for 6 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C for 3 minutes until crunchy and salt well. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon for aioli and serve on the side.

Wrap 2 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, cool, peel and dice. Slice 1 baguette into 16 rounds and toast. Spread with 150g goat's cheese, top with the beetroot and segments from 2 blood oranges, and drizzle with honey.

m.note: Stu's welcome dinner at the flat
m.how: Season 800g beef sirloin, sear on all sides in a hot pan, then roast at 200C for 18 minutes for rare. Rest 15 minutes and slice thin. Fill 4 soft rolls with the beef, 4 tbsp horseradish cream and a handful of rocket each.

w.note: an old-world dessert for very old flatmates
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick, fold in 100g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa, and bake in a 20cm tin at 180C for 25 minutes. Split in two, soak with the syrup from a 680g jar of morello cherries, fill with cherries and 300ml whipped cream, cover in cream and grate 50g dark chocolate on top.

d.note: something red in a nice glass
d.how: Squeeze 6 blood oranges. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice, pour 70ml juice into each and top with 150ml soda water. Finish with a slice of blood orange on the rim.
